<script>
const APP_BUILD_TAG = "owner-sync-ui-2026-02-18-01"
console.log("App build:", APP_BUILD_TAG)
    
let popupData = {}

let formatClientError = function(error){
    if (!error){
        return "Unknown error"
    }
    if (typeof error === "string"){
        return error
    }
    return error.message || JSON.stringify(error)
}

let formatSharedStatusLabel = function(group){
    let status = String((group && group.status) || "")
    if (!status){
        return "-"
    }
    if (status.startsWith("Shared (")){
        return status
    }
    if (status.startsWith("Importing")){
        return "Importing"
    }
    if (status.startsWith("Queued")){
        return "Queued"
    }
    if (status.startsWith("Shared")){
        return "Shared"
    }
    return status
}

let getSharedImportedCount = function(group){
    if (!group){
        return 0
    }
    let actualCount = Number(group.actualCount || 0)
    if (actualCount > 0){
        return actualCount
    }
    let total = Number(group.memberCount || 0)
    let processed = Number(group.importCursor || 0)
    let skipped = Number(group.skippedCount || 0)
    let imported = processed - skipped
    if (imported < 0){
        imported = 0
    }
    if (imported > total){
        imported = total
    }
    return imported
}

let isSharedGroupPending_ = function(group){
    if (!group){
        return false
    }
    let total = Number(group.memberCount || 0)
    let imported = getSharedImportedCount(group)
    if (total > 0 && imported < total){
        return true
    }
    let status = String(group.status || "")
    return status.startsWith("Importing") || status.startsWith("Queued")
}
    
    let data = {
        popupData,
        appBuildTag: APP_BUILD_TAG,
        isSharing: false,
        syncingGroups: {},
        activeOwnerSyncResourceName: "",
        groupsById: {},
        groupsList: [],
        recipientConnected: false,
        syncStatusMessage: "",
        ownerSyncPollErrors: {},
        ownerSyncLabels: {},
        ownerProgressProbeAt: {},
        ownerSyncInFlight: {},
        shareStatusMessage: "",
        shareStatusIsError: false,
        ownerSyncRequiredMessage: "",
        skippedDialog: {
            groupName: "",
            contacts: [],
            loading: false,
            error: "",
        },
        viewMode: window.VIEW_MODE || "owner",
        syncConfirm: {
            resourceName: "",
            groupName: ""
        },
        resetConfirm: {
            resourceName: "",
            groupName: "",
            message: ""
        }
    }
    
    let resetPopupData = function(data){
        this.popupData = data
        if (typeof this.popupData.notifyByEmail !== "boolean"){
            this.popupData.notifyByEmail = true
        }
        
        // initialize share email chip
        let elem = document.querySelector('.chip-share-emails')
        options = {
            placeholder: "Add email"
        }
        M.Chips.init(elem, options)
    }
    
    let shareContactGroup = function(){
        if (this.isSharing){
            return
        }
        let elem = document.querySelector('.chip-share-emails')
        let chip = M.Chips.getInstance(elem)
        // Ensure current input value becomes a chip before reading chipsData
        let input = elem ? elem.querySelector("input") : null
        if (input && input.value && input.value.trim()){
            let value = input.value.toLowerCase().trim()
            let exists = chip && chip.chipsData.some(c=>c.tag.toLowerCase().trim() === value)
            if (chip && !exists){
                chip.addChip({tag: value})
            }
            input.value = ""
        }
        let rawEmails = chip ? chip.chipsData.map(chip=>chip.tag.toLowerCase().trim()) : []
        let emails = rawEmails.slice()
        
        let key = this.profile.email
        let shared = this.popupData.shared
        let resourceName = this.popupData.resourceName
        let name = this.popupData.name
        let memberCount = this.popupData.memberCount
        let members = this.popupData.members
        let notifyByEmail = this.popupData.notifyByEmail !== false
        let latestShared = (
            this.groupsById &&
            this.groupsById[resourceName] &&
            Array.isArray(this.groupsById[resourceName].shared)
        ) ? this.groupsById[resourceName].shared : shared
        let sharedSet = new Set((latestShared || []).map(email=>String(email || "").trim().toLowerCase()))
        
        emails = emails.filter(email=>!sharedSet.has(String(email || "").trim().toLowerCase()))
        
        if (emails.length){
            this.isSharing = true
            this.shareStatusMessage = ""
            this.shareStatusIsError = false
            google.script.run
                .withSuccessHandler(({groups, shareStatus})=>{
                    let nextGroups = Object.assign({}, this.groupsById || {})
                    if (groups){
                        Object.keys(groups).forEach(id=>{
                            let existing = nextGroups[id] || {}
                            let incoming = groups[id] || {}
                            nextGroups[id] = Object.assign({}, existing, incoming)
                        })
                    }
                    this.groupsById = nextGroups
                    this.groupsList = Object.values(nextGroups).sort((a, b) => (a.name || "").localeCompare((b.name || ""), undefined, {sensitivity: "base"}))
                    if (nextGroups[resourceName] && nextGroups[resourceName].shared){
                        this.popupData.shared = nextGroups[resourceName].shared
                    }
                    let sent = shareStatus && shareStatus.sent ? shareStatus.sent : emails.length
                    let notified = shareStatus && typeof shareStatus.notified === "number" ? shareStatus.notified : (notifyByEmail ? sent : 0)
                    let blockedNoInvite = shareStatus && shareStatus.blockedNoInvite ? shareStatus.blockedNoInvite : 0
                    let blockedNoInviteEmails = (shareStatus && Array.isArray(shareStatus.blockedNoInviteEmails))
                        ? shareStatus.blockedNoInviteEmails
                        : []
                    let requiresOwnerSync = !!(shareStatus && shareStatus.requiresOwnerSync)
                    if (!requiresOwnerSync && sent > 0){
                        requiresOwnerSync = true
                    }
                    let requestedContacts = shareStatus && shareStatus.requestedContacts ? shareStatus.requestedContacts : 0
                    let preparedContacts = shareStatus && shareStatus.preparedContacts ? shareStatus.preparedContacts : 0
                    let missingContacts = shareStatus && shareStatus.missingContacts ? shareStatus.missingContacts : 0
                    this.shareStatusMessage = `Shared with ${sent} recipient(s). Prepared ${preparedContacts}/${requestedContacts} contact(s).`
                    if (notifyByEmail){
                        this.shareStatusMessage += ` Email sent to ${notified} recipient(s).`
                    } else {
                        this.shareStatusMessage += " Email notification skipped."
                    }
                    let hasShareWarning = false
                    if (blockedNoInvite > 0){
                        let blockedList = blockedNoInviteEmails.length
                            ? blockedNoInviteEmails.join(", ")
                            : `${blockedNoInvite} recipient(s)`
                        this.shareStatusMessage += ` Not added (no prior invite): ${blockedList}.`
                        hasShareWarning = true
                    }
                    if (requiresOwnerSync){
                        this.ownerSyncRequiredMessage = `"${name}" was shared. Click Sync to push contacts to recipients.`
                    }
                    this.shareStatusIsError = (missingContacts > 0) || hasShareWarning
                    if (missingContacts > 0){
                        this.shareStatusMessage += ` ${missingContacts} contact(s) could not be prepared.`
                    }
                    if (M && M.toast){
                        M.toast({html: this.shareStatusMessage})
                        if (requiresOwnerSync){
                            M.toast({html: "Group shared. Now click Sync to send contacts.", classes: "amber darken-2"})
                        }
                    }
                    // clear chips after successful share
                    if (chip){
                        chip.chipsData = []
                        if (chip.$chips){
                            chip.$chips.innerHTML = ""
                        }
                    }
                    this.isSharing = false
                })
                .withFailureHandler((error)=>{
                    this.isSharing = false
                    this.shareStatusIsError = true
                    this.ownerSyncRequiredMessage = ""
                    this.shareStatusMessage = error && error.message ? error.message : "Share failed."
                    if (M && M.toast){
                        M.toast({html: this.shareStatusMessage})
                    }
                })
                .shareContactGroup(key, resourceName, name, members, memberCount, emails, notifyByEmail)
        } else {
            this.shareStatusIsError = true
            if (rawEmails.length > 0){
                this.shareStatusMessage = "All entered emails are already collaborators for this group."
            } else {
                this.shareStatusMessage = "Enter at least one new recipient email."
            }
        }
    }
    
    
    let stopShareContactGroup = function(key, email, resourceName){
        google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(({groups}) =>{
                let nextGroups = Object.assign({}, this.groupsById || {})
                if (groups){
                    Object.keys(groups).forEach(id=>{
                        let existing = nextGroups[id] || {}
                        let incoming = groups[id] || {}
                        nextGroups[id] = Object.assign({}, existing, incoming)
                    })
                }
                this.groupsById = nextGroups
                this.groupsList = Object.values(nextGroups).sort((a, b) => (a.name || "").localeCompare((b.name || ""), undefined, {sensitivity: "base"}))
                if (nextGroups[resourceName] && nextGroups[resourceName].shared){
                    this.popupData.shared = nextGroups[resourceName].shared
                }
            })
            .stopShareContactGroup(key, email, resourceName)
    }
    
    
    let refreshAppData = function(){
        google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(({profile, groups, sharedGroups, recipientConnected})=>{

                this.hasLoadError = false
                this.profile = profile
                this.groupsById = groups
                this.groupsList = Object.values(groups).sort((a, b) => (a.name || "").localeCompare((b.name || ""), undefined, {sensitivity: "base"}))
                this.sharedGroups = sharedGroups
                this.recipientConnected = recipientConnected
            })
            .withFailureHandler(error=>{
                this.hasLoadError = true
                this.error = formatClientError(error)
            })
            .loadApp(this.viewMode)
    }
    
    let methods = {
        resetPopupData,
        invokePopupCallback: function(){
            if (this.isSharing){
                return
            }
            let cb = this.popupData && this.popupData.callback
            if (typeof cb === "function"){
                cb.call(this)
            }
        },
        formatSharedStatusLabel,
        getSharedImportedCount,
        shareContactGroup,
        stopShareContactGroup,
        getSharedGroupSyncKey: function(group){
            if (!group){
                return ""
            }
            return `shared:${group.owner || ""}|${group.resourceName || ""}`
        },
        isSharedGroupSyncing: function(group){
            let key = this.getSharedGroupSyncKey(group)
            return !!(key && this.syncingGroups && this.syncingGroups[key])
        },
        syncSharedRecipientGroup: function(group){
            if (!group || !group.owner || !group.resourceName){
                return
            }
            if (!this.recipientConnected){
                if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                    M.toast({html: "Connect account first, then retry import.", classes: "amber darken-2"})
                }
                this.connectAccount()
                return
            }
            let syncKey = this.getSharedGroupSyncKey(group)
            if (!syncKey || this.isSharedGroupSyncing(group)){
                return
            }
            this.$set(this.syncingGroups, syncKey, true)
            let ownerKey = group.owner
            let resourceName = group.resourceName
            let startedWithPending = isSharedGroupPending_(group)
            let runStep = () => {
                google.script.run
                    .withSuccessHandler(({sharedGroups, busy})=>{
                        this.sharedGroups = sharedGroups || []
                        let latest = this.sharedGroups.find(item=>
                            item &&
                            item.owner === ownerKey &&
                            item.resourceName === resourceName
                        )
                        if (latest && isSharedGroupPending_(latest)){
                            let delay = busy ? 1400 : 600
                            setTimeout(runStep, delay)
                            return
                        }
                        this.$set(this.syncingGroups, syncKey, false)
                        let latestTotal = Number((latest && latest.memberCount) || 0)
                        let latestImported = latest ? getSharedImportedCount(latest) : 0
                        if (latest && !isSharedGroupPending_(latest) && latestTotal > 0 && latestImported >= latestTotal && startedWithPending === false){
                            if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                                M.toast({html: "No new import work. Owner must run Sync to push contact updates.", classes: "blue-grey darken-1"})
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    .withFailureHandler((error)=>{
                        let message = formatClientError(error)
                        let isHttp0 = /http\s*0/i.test(String(message || ""))
                        if (isHttp0){
                            if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                                M.toast({html: "Connection dropped (HTTP 0). Retrying import...", classes: "amber darken-2"})
                            }
                            setTimeout(runStep, 1200)
                            return
                        }
                        if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                            M.toast({html: `Import failed: ${message}`, classes: "red darken-2"})
                        }
                        this.$set(this.syncingGroups, syncKey, false)
                    })
                    .processSharedImportForGroup(ownerKey, resourceName, 60)
            }
            runStep()
        },
        isGroupSyncing: function(resourceName){
            return !!(this.syncingGroups && this.syncingGroups[resourceName])
        },
        getOwnerSyncButtonLabel: function(group){
            if (!group){
                return "Syncing"
            }
            let resourceName = group.resourceName || ""
            let localLabel = resourceName ? this.ownerSyncLabels[resourceName] : ""
            if (localLabel){
                return localLabel
            }
            let progress = group.syncProgress || {}
            let done = Number(progress.done || 0)
            let total = Number(group.memberCount || progress.total || 0)
            if (total > 0){
                if (done < 0){
                    done = 0
                }
                if (done > total){
                    done = total
                }
                return `${done}/${total}`
            }
            // Fallback: parse any x/y hint from current status text.
            let statusText = String(group.status || "")
            let match = statusText.match(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)/)
            if (match){
                return `${match[1]}/${match[2]}`
            }
            return "Syncing"
        },
        getOwnerSyncDisplayText: function(group){
            if (!group){
                return ""
            }
            if (this.isGroupSyncing(group.resourceName)){
                return this.getOwnerSyncButtonLabel(group)
            }
            return this.getOwnerSyncButtonText(group)
        },
        shouldShowOwnerSyncText: function(group){
            if (!group){
                return false
            }
            let resourceName = group.resourceName || ""
            if (!resourceName){
                return false
            }
            if (this.ownerSyncLabels[resourceName]){
                return true
            }
            if (this.isGroupSyncing(resourceName) || this.activeOwnerSyncResourceName === resourceName){
                return true
            }
            let statusText = String(group.status || "")
            return statusText.startsWith("Syncing") || statusText.startsWith("Queued")
        },
        getOwnerSyncButtonText: function(group){
            if (!group){
                return ""
            }
            let resourceName = group.resourceName || ""
            let localLabel = resourceName ? this.ownerSyncLabels[resourceName] : ""
            if (localLabel){
                return localLabel
            }
            let statusText = String(group.status || "")
            let statusMatch = statusText.match(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)/)
            if (statusMatch){
                return `${statusMatch[1]}/${statusMatch[2]}`
            }
            if (this.isGroupSyncing(resourceName) || this.activeOwnerSyncResourceName === resourceName){
                return `0/${Number(group.memberCount || 0)}`
            }
            let shared = Array.isArray(group.shared) ? group.shared.length > 0 : !!group.shared
            if (!shared){
                return ""
            }
            return ""
        },
        isOwnerSyncZeroState: function(group){
            if (!group){
                return false
            }
            if (!this.isGroupSyncing(group.resourceName)){
                return false
            }
            let label = String(this.getOwnerSyncButtonLabel(group) || "").trim()
            let match = label.match(/^(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)$/)
            if (!match){
                return false
            }
            let done = Number(match[1])
            let total = Number(match[2])
            return total > 0 && done === 0
        },
        startOwnerSync: function(resourceName, resetSync){
            console.log("startOwnerSync called", resourceName);
            if (!resourceName){
                this.syncStatusMessage = "Sync failed: missing group id."
                return
            }
            if (this.isGroupSyncing(resourceName)){
                this.syncStatusMessage = "Sync already in progress..."
                return
            }
            let group = this.groupsById ? this.groupsById[resourceName] : null
            if (!group && Array.isArray(this.groupsList)){
                group = this.groupsList.find(item=>item && item.resourceName === resourceName) || null
            }
            if (!group){
                console.error("Group not found", resourceName);
                this.syncStatusMessage = "Sync failed: group not found in current view."
                return
            }
            let shared = Array.isArray(group.shared) ? group.shared : []
            if (!shared.length){
                this.syncStatusMessage = "This group is not shared yet. Share it first, then sync."
                if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                    M.toast({html: "Share this group first before syncing.", classes: "amber darken-2"})
                }
                return
            }
            
            if (!this.profile || !this.profile.email) {
                console.error("Profile not loaded");
                this.syncStatusMessage = "Sync failed: Profile not loaded."
                return
            }

            this.$set(this.ownerSyncPollErrors, resourceName, 0)
            this.$set(this.ownerProgressProbeAt, resourceName, 0)
            this.activeOwnerSyncResourceName = resourceName
            let total = Math.floor(Number((group && group.memberCount) || 0))
            console.log("Group member count:", group ? group.memberCount : "N/A", "Total:", total);
            this.$set(this.ownerSyncLabels, resourceName, `${0}/${total}`)
            this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, true)
            console.log("Sync started for:", resourceName, "Label:", this.ownerSyncLabels[resourceName]);
            this.syncStatusMessage = total > 0 ? `Syncing... (0/${total})` : "Syncing..."
            let ownerKey = this.profile.email
            let pollCount = 0
            let runStep = (reset)=>{
                if (this.ownerSyncInFlight[resourceName]){
                    return
                }
                this.$set(this.ownerSyncInFlight, resourceName, true)
                pollCount++
                google.script.run
                    .withSuccessHandler((response)=>{
                        this.$set(this.ownerSyncInFlight, resourceName, false)
                        let groups = response && response.groups
                        let syncStatus = response && response.syncStatus
                        let progressByGroup = response && response.progressByGroup
                        let pending = !!(response && response.pending)
                        let busy = !!(response && response.busy)
                        let pendingByStatus = false
                        let terminalByStatus = false
                        if (syncStatus && typeof syncStatus === "object"){
                            let statusValues = Object.values(syncStatus).map(status=>String(status || ""))
                            pendingByStatus = statusValues.some(text=>{
                                return text.startsWith("Syncing") || text.startsWith("Queued")
                            })
                            terminalByStatus = statusValues.some(text=>{
                                return text.startsWith("Synced") ||
                                    text.startsWith("Shared") ||
                                    text.startsWith("Error") ||
                                    text.startsWith("Connect required") ||
                                    text.startsWith("No sharedGroups") ||
                                    text.startsWith("Group not found") ||
                                    text.startsWith("Failed")
                            })
                        }
                        if (!pending && !pendingByStatus && !terminalByStatus){
                            // Defensive: ambiguous response, keep polling instead of stopping UI early.
                            pending = true
                        }
                        console.log("Sync step:", {pending, resourceName});
                        if (groups && typeof groups === "object"){
                            let mergedGroups = Object.assign({}, this.groupsById || {})
                            Object.keys(groups).forEach(id=>{
                                let existing = mergedGroups[id] || {}
                                let incoming = groups[id] || {}
                                mergedGroups[id] = Object.assign({}, existing, incoming)
                            })
                            this.groupsById = mergedGroups
                            this.groupsList = Object.values(this.groupsById).sort((a, b) => (a.name || "").localeCompare((b.name || ""), undefined, {sensitivity: "base"}))
                        }
                        let latestGroup = this.groupsById ? this.groupsById[resourceName] : null
                        let progressFromResponse = progressByGroup && progressByGroup[resourceName]
                        if (latestGroup){
                            let progress = latestGroup.syncProgress || {}
                            let done = Number((progressFromResponse && progressFromResponse.done) || progress.done || 0)
                            let totalFromGroup = Number(
                                (progressFromResponse && progressFromResponse.total) ||
                                latestGroup.memberCount ||
                                progress.total ||
                                0
                            )
                            
                            // Attempt to parse progress from syncStatus text if structured progress is missing
                            if (done === 0 && syncStatus) {
                                Object.values(syncStatus).forEach(statusStr => {
                                    let match = String(statusStr).match(/(\d+)\/(\d+)/);
                                    if (match) {
                                        let d = Number(match[1]);
                                        if (d > done) done = d;
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                            
                            if (totalFromGroup > 0){
                                if (done < 0){
                                    done = 0
                                }
                                if (done > totalFromGroup){
                                    done = totalFromGroup
                                }
                                this.$set(this.ownerSyncLabels, resourceName, `${done}/${totalFromGroup}`)
                                if (pending){
                                    this.syncStatusMessage = `Syncing... (${done}/${totalFromGroup})`
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (pending && !this.ownerSyncLabels[resourceName]){
                            let fallbackGroup = Array.isArray(this.groupsList)
                                ? this.groupsList.find(item=>item && item.resourceName === resourceName)
                                : null
                            let fallbackTotal = Number((fallbackGroup && fallbackGroup.memberCount) || 0)
                            this.$set(this.ownerSyncLabels, resourceName, `${0}/${fallbackTotal}`)
                        }
                        if (pending && (!progressFromResponse || !latestGroup)){
                            let lastProbe = Number(this.ownerProgressProbeAt[resourceName] || 0)
                            let currentLabel = String(this.ownerSyncLabels[resourceName] || "")
                            let isZeroLabel = /^\s*0\s*\/\s*\d+\s*$/.test(currentLabel)
                            let probeEvery = isZeroLabel ? 1 : 3
                            if ((pollCount - lastProbe) >= probeEvery){
                                this.$set(this.ownerProgressProbeAt, resourceName, pollCount)
                                google.script.run
                                    .withSuccessHandler((snapshot)=>{
                                        let snapGroup = snapshot && snapshot.group
                                        let snapProgress = snapshot && snapshot.progress
                                        if (snapGroup && this.groupsById){
                                            this.$set(this.groupsById, resourceName, snapGroup)
                                        }
                                        let done = Number((snapProgress && snapProgress.done) || 0)
                                        let totalSnap = Number(
                                            (snapProgress && snapProgress.total) ||
                                            (snapGroup && snapGroup.memberCount) ||
                                            0
                                        )
                                        if (totalSnap > 0){
                                            if (done < 0){
                                                done = 0
                                            }
                                            if (done > totalSnap){
                                                done = totalSnap
                                            }
                                            this.$set(this.ownerSyncLabels, resourceName, `${done}/${totalSnap}`)
                                            this.syncStatusMessage = `Syncing... (${done}/${totalSnap})`
                                        }
                                    })
                                    .withFailureHandler(()=>{})
                                    .getOwnerGroupSyncProgress(ownerKey, resourceName)
                            }
                        }
                        if (syncStatus && Object.keys(syncStatus).length){
                            this.syncStatusMessage = Object.entries(syncStatus)
                                .map(([email, status]) => `${email}: ${status}`)
                                .join(" • ")
                        } else if (pending && busy){
                            this.syncStatusMessage = "Waiting for previous sync step..."
                        } else if (pending){
                            this.syncStatusMessage = "Syncing..."
                        }
                        let pendingByGroupStatus = false
                        if (latestGroup){
                            let latestStatusText = String(latestGroup.status || "")
                            pendingByGroupStatus = latestStatusText.startsWith("Syncing") || latestStatusText.startsWith("Queued")
                        }
                        if (!pending && (pendingByStatus || pendingByGroupStatus)){
                            pending = true
                        }
                        // Safety valve: if polling runs too long, reconcile from latest app state.
                        if (pollCount > 80){
                            this.refreshAppData()
                            let latest = this.groupsById ? this.groupsById[resourceName] : null
                            let statusText = String((latest && latest.status) || "")
                            let stillPending = statusText.startsWith("Syncing")
                            if (!stillPending){
                                this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, false)
                                this.syncStatusMessage = statusText || "Sync complete."
                                return
                            }
                        }
                        if (pending){
                            this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, true)
                            if (!this.ownerSyncLabels[resourceName]){
                                let totalFallback = Number((latestGroup && latestGroup.memberCount) || (group && group.memberCount) || 0)
                                this.$set(this.ownerSyncLabels, resourceName, `${0}/${totalFallback}`)
                            }
                            this.$set(this.ownerSyncPollErrors, resourceName, 0)
                            if (pollCount > 1200){
                                this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, false)
                                this.$delete(this.ownerProgressProbeAt, resourceName)
                                this.syncStatusMessage = "Sync polling paused after a long run. Tap Sync to continue."
                                return
                            }
                            let delay = busy ? 1400 : 700
                            setTimeout(()=>runStep(false), delay)
                            return
                        }
                        google.script.run
                            .withSuccessHandler((snapshot)=>{
                                let snapGroup = snapshot && snapshot.group
                                let snapProgress = snapshot && snapshot.progress
                                let snapActive = !!(snapProgress && snapProgress.active)
                                let snapStatus = String((snapGroup && snapGroup.status) || "")
                                let snapPendingByStatus = snapStatus.startsWith("Syncing") || snapStatus.startsWith("Queued")
                                if (snapGroup && this.groupsById){
                                    this.$set(this.groupsById, resourceName, snapGroup)
                                }
                                if (snapActive || snapPendingByStatus){
                                    let done = Number((snapProgress && snapProgress.done) || 0)
                                    let totalSnap = Number(
                                        (snapProgress && snapProgress.total) ||
                                        (snapGroup && snapGroup.memberCount) ||
                                        0
                                    )
                                    if (totalSnap > 0){
                                        if (done < 0){
                                            done = 0
                                        }
                                        if (done > totalSnap){
                                            done = totalSnap
                                        }
                                        this.$set(this.ownerSyncLabels, resourceName, `${done}/${totalSnap}`)
                                        this.syncStatusMessage = `Syncing... (${done}/${totalSnap})`
                                    }
                                    this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, true)
                                    setTimeout(()=>runStep(false), 700)
                                    return
                                }
                                this.$set(this.ownerSyncPollErrors, resourceName, 0)
                                this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, false)
                                this.activeOwnerSyncResourceName = ""
                                this.$delete(this.ownerProgressProbeAt, resourceName)
                                this.refreshAppData()
                            })
                            .withFailureHandler(()=>{
                                // If verification snapshot fails, keep polling instead of stopping early.
                                this.$set(this.ownerSyncPollErrors, resourceName, 0)
                                this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, true)
                                let delay = busy ? 1400 : 700
                                setTimeout(()=>runStep(false), delay)
                            })
                            .getOwnerGroupSyncProgress(ownerKey, resourceName)
                    })
                    .withFailureHandler((error)=>{
                        this.$set(this.ownerSyncInFlight, resourceName, false)
                        let attempts = Number(this.ownerSyncPollErrors[resourceName] || 0) + 1
                        this.$set(this.ownerSyncPollErrors, resourceName, attempts)
                        if (attempts < 8){
                            this.syncStatusMessage = `Syncing... (retry ${attempts})`
                            setTimeout(()=>runStep(false), 1200)
                            return
                        }
                        this.$set(this.syncingGroups, resourceName, false)
                        this.activeOwnerSyncResourceName = ""
                        this.$delete(this.ownerProgressProbeAt, resourceName)
                        this.syncStatusMessage = `Sync stopped after retries: ${formatClientError(error)}`
                        if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                            M.toast({html: this.syncStatusMessage, classes: "red darken-2"})
                        }
                        console.error(error)
                    })
                    .syncSharedGroup(ownerKey, resourceName, 90, !!reset)
            }
            runStep(!!resetSync)
        },
        showSkippedContacts: function(resourceName, groupName){
            this.skippedDialog.groupName = groupName
            this.skippedDialog.contacts = []
            this.skippedDialog.loading = true
            this.skippedDialog.error = ""
            let modal = M.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById("popup-skipped-contacts"))
            if (modal){
                modal.open()
            }
            google.script.run
                .withSuccessHandler(({contacts})=>{
                    this.skippedDialog.contacts = contacts || []
                    this.skippedDialog.loading = false
                })
                .withFailureHandler((error)=>{
                    this.skippedDialog.error = formatClientError(error)
                    this.skippedDialog.loading = false
                })
                .listSkippedContactsForOwnerGroup(this.profile.email, resourceName)
        },
        resetGroupSyncState: function(resourceName, groupName){
            if (!resourceName){
                return
            }
            this.resetConfirm.resourceName = resourceName
            this.resetConfirm.groupName = groupName
            this.resetConfirm.message = `Reset sync state for "${groupName}"? This does not delete contacts.`
            let modalElem = document.getElementById("popup-reset-sync-confirm")
            let modal = null
            if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.Modal && modalElem){
                modal = M.Modal.getInstance(modalElem)
                if (!modal){
                    M.Modal.init(modalElem)
                    modal = M.Modal.getInstance(modalElem)
                }
            }
            if (modal){
                modal.open()
            } else {
                this.confirmResetGroupSyncState()
            }
        },
        confirmResetGroupSyncState: function(){
            let resourceName = this.resetConfirm.resourceName
            let groupName = this.resetConfirm.groupName || "this group"
            if (!resourceName){
                return
            }
            google.script.run
                .withSuccessHandler(({groups, sharedGroups})=>{
                    let modal = (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.Modal)
                        ? M.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById("popup-reset-sync-confirm"))
                        : null
                    if (modal){
                        modal.close()
                    }
                    this.groupsById = groups || {}
                    this.groupsList = Object.values(this.groupsById).sort((a, b) => (a.name || "").localeCompare((b.name || ""), undefined, {sensitivity: "base"}))
                    if (Array.isArray(sharedGroups)){
                        this.sharedGroups = sharedGroups
                    }
                    this.syncingGroups = {}
                    this.activeOwnerSyncResourceName = ""
                    this.ownerSyncLabels = {}
                    this.ownerSyncPollErrors = {}
                    this.ownerProgressProbeAt = {}
                    this.ownerSyncInFlight = {}
                    this.ownerSyncRequiredMessage = ""
                    this.syncStatusMessage = `Sync state reset for ${groupName}.`
                    if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                        M.toast({html: this.syncStatusMessage})
                    }
                })
                .withFailureHandler((error)=>{
                    let modal = (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.Modal)
                        ? M.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById("popup-reset-sync-confirm"))
                        : null
                    if (modal){
                        modal.close()
                    }
                    this.syncStatusMessage = formatClientError(error)
                    if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                        M.toast({html: this.syncStatusMessage, classes: "red darken-2"})
                    }
                })
                .resetGroupSyncState(this.profile.email, resourceName)
        },
        refreshAppData,
        syncSharedGroup: function(resourceName, groupName){
            this.syncStatusMessage = `Starting sync for ${groupName}...`
            if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                M.toast({html: `Starting sync: ${groupName}`})
            }
            let group = this.groupsById ? this.groupsById[resourceName] : null
            if (!group && Array.isArray(this.groupsList)){
                group = this.groupsList.find(item=>item && item.resourceName === resourceName) || null
            }
            if (!group){
                this.syncStatusMessage = "Sync failed: group not found in current view."
                return
            }
            let shared = (group && Array.isArray(group.shared)) ? group.shared : []
            if (!shared.length){
                this.syncStatusMessage = "This group is not shared yet. Share it first, then sync."
                if (typeof M !== "undefined" && M && M.toast){
                    M.toast({html: "Share this group first before syncing.", classes: "amber darken-2"})
                }
                return
            }
            this.syncConfirm.resourceName = resourceName
            this.syncConfirm.groupName = groupName
            this.startOwnerSync(resourceName, true)
        },
        confirmSync: function(){
            let resourceName = this.syncConfirm.resourceName
            this.startOwnerSync(resourceName, true)
        },
        connectAccount: function(){
            google.script.run
                .withSuccessHandler(({authorized, url})=>{
                    if (authorized){
                        this.recipientConnected = true
                        return
                    }
                    if (url){
                        window.open(url, "_blank")
                    }
                })
                .withFailureHandler((error)=>{
                    console.error(error)
                })
                .getConnectUrl()
        },
    }
    
    let mounted = function(){
        let elems
        let options
        
        // initialize side navbar for mobile
        elems = document.querySelectorAll('.sidenav')
        M.Sidenav.init(elems)
        
        
        // initialize modal popups
        elems = document.querySelectorAll('.modal')
        M.Modal.init(elems)
        
        // initialize share email chip
        elems = document.querySelectorAll('.chip-share-emails')
        options = {
            placeholder: "Add email"
        }
        M.Chips.init(elems, options)
    }
    
    
    // load the app with app data
    google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(({profile, groups, sharedGroups, recipientConnected})=>{
            data.hasLoadError = false
            data.profile = profile
            data.groupsById = groups
            data.groupsList = Object.values(groups).sort((a, b) => (a.name || "").localeCompare((b.name || ""), undefined, {sensitivity: "base"}))
            data.sharedGroups = sharedGroups
            data.recipientConnected = recipientConnected
            
            window.__appVm = new Vue({
                el: "#app",
                data,
                methods,
                mounted,
            })
        })
        .withFailureHandler(error=>{
            data.hasLoadError = true
            data.error = formatClientError(error)
            window.__appVm = new Vue({
                el: "#app",
                data,
                methods,
                mounted,
            })
        })
        .loadApp(window.VIEW_MODE || "owner")
</script>

<style>
    #app nav {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 1000;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
    }

    #app main table th {
        position: sticky;
        top: 64px;
        z-index: 900;
        background: #f5f7f8;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #d7dde2;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    }

    @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
        #app main table th {
            top: 56px;
        }
    }

    #app .brand-logo{
        padding: 0px 15px;
    }
    
    #app nav li span {
        display: block;
        padding: 0 15px;
    }

    #app .build-tag {
        font-size: 11px;
        opacity: 0.9;
        letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    #app .shared-help-text {
        margin: -2px 0 12px 2px;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    #app .share-notify-option {
        margin: 10px 0 0 2px;
    }

    #app .share-notify-label {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    
    #app .user-image {
        max-height: 64px;
        padding: 10px 15px;
    }
    
    #app .modal-footer {
        padding: 0px 24px 24px 24px;
    }
    
    #app .modal-footer .btn {
        margin: 0px;
    }

    #app .sync-rotating {
        animation: sync-spin 1s linear infinite;
    }

    #app .owner-sync-btn {
        min-width: 120px;
        width: 120px;
        background-color: #26a69a !important;
        text-align: center;
    }

    #app .owner-sync-btn.is-syncing {
        background-color: #b0b7bd !important;
    }

    #app .owner-sync-btn.is-zero {
        background-color: #26a69a !important;
    }

    #app .owner-reset-sync-btn {
        margin-left: 6px;
        min-width: 78px;
        width: 78px;
        background-color: #90a4ae;
        color: #fff;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-weight: 500;
    }

    #app .owner-groups-table,
    #app .shared-groups-table {
        width: 100%;
        table-layout: fixed;
    }

    #app .owner-groups-table th:nth-child(1),
    #app .owner-groups-table td:nth-child(1) { width: 30%; }
    #app .owner-groups-table th:nth-child(2),
    #app .owner-groups-table td:nth-child(2) { width: 20%; }
    #app .owner-groups-table th:nth-child(3),
    #app .owner-groups-table td:nth-child(3) { width: 9%; }
    #app .owner-groups-table th:nth-child(4),
    #app .owner-groups-table td:nth-child(4) { width: 10%; }
    #app .owner-groups-table th:nth-child(5),
    #app .owner-groups-table td:nth-child(5) { width: 22%; }
    #app .owner-groups-table th:nth-child(6),
    #app .owner-groups-table td:nth-child(6) { width: 9%; }

    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(1),
    #app .shared-groups-table td:nth-child(1) { width: 31%; }
    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(2),
    #app .shared-groups-table td:nth-child(2) { width: 21%; }
    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(3),
    #app .shared-groups-table td:nth-child(3) { width: 7%; text-align: right; }
    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(4),
    #app .shared-groups-table td:nth-child(4) { width: 19%; }
    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(5),
    #app .shared-groups-table td:nth-child(5) { width: 10%; }

    #app .shared-groups-table td {
        overflow: hidden;
        vertical-align: middle;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    #app .shared-col-name,
    #app .shared-col-owner {
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    #app .shared-col-contacts,
    #app .shared-col-sync {
        white-space: nowrap;
        padding-left: 12px;
    }

    #app .shared-col-contacts {
        padding-right: 24px;
    }

    #app .shared-col-status {
        white-space: normal;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 8px;
    }

    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(5),
    #app .shared-groups-table td:nth-child(5) {
        text-align: right;
    }

    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(3) {
        padding-right: 24px;
    }

    #app .shared-groups-table th:nth-child(4) {
        padding-left: 14px;
    }

    #app .shared-col-sync .btn {
        margin-left: auto;
        display: inline-block;
    }

    @keyframes sync-spin {
        from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
        to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    
    [v-cloak] > * {
        display: none;
    }
    
    [v-cloak]::before {
        content: "";
        box-sizing: border-box;
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        left: 50%;
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        margin-top: -30px;
        margin-left: -30px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        border: 6px solid #eee;
        border-top-color: #26A69A;
        animation: spinner 0.7s linear infinite;
        text-indent: 100%;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
    }
    
    @keyframes spinner {
        to {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
    }

    #app .page-footer .container {
        width: 92%;
    }

    #app .page-footer .col.l6.s12 {
        width: 100%;
    }

    #app .page-footer .col.l6.s12 h5 {
        text-align: center;
    }

    #app .page-footer .col.l6.s12 p {
        text-align: center;
        max-width: 900px;
        margin: 0 auto 32px auto;
    }

</style>
